correctness.rationale: Commutation makes the target ray an eigenvector of every block state, with block overlap \(g_k=c+(1-c)q^k\). Replacing an \(\omega^{\otimes k}\) block by \(\zeta_k\) strictly increases target overlap, and \(g_{a+b}-g_ag_b=c(1-c)(1-q^a)(1-q^b)\ge0\), so repeated merging proves the single \(n\)-block state is extremal. The entropy and max-entropy identities then follow from the target eigenvalue. For hypothesis testing, the single-block alternative gives the lower bound and \(Q=(1-\varepsilon)\rho^{\otimes n}\) attains it uniformly. For smoothing, trace distance gives target mass at least \(1-\delta/2\), and the explicit mixture \(L_s=(1-s)\rho^{\otimes n}+s\zeta_n\) attains the bound. The bundled verifier independently checks all block compositions and the merge/smoothing identities on bounded grids; it is corroborative rather than the source of the universal proof.

final_claim: For the commuting specialization of the Gao--Ji--Liu correlated alternative family with pure target \(\rho\), faithful \(\omega\), \([\rho,\omega]=0\), \(0<c<1\), and \(q=\langle\phi|\omega|\phi\rangle\), every finite blocklength \(n\) has exact maximal target overlap \(g_n=c+(1-c)q^n\); consequently the optimized relative entropy and max-relative entropy are both \(-\log_2 g_n\), the fixed-error type-II optimum is \((1-\varepsilon)g_n\), and the trace-preserving smoothed max-relative quantity is \(\log_2\max\{1,(1-\delta/2)/g_n\}\).
limitations: The exact formulas use the additional commutation hypothesis \([\rho,\omega]=0\) and rank-one target.
The family is the specific partition-generated correlated family from Gao--Ji--Liu Example 24.
